page.content:
Predestined ordeals the pilgrims must suffer to earn the scriptures.

How Eighty-one tribulations connects

  • Faction: Tang pilgrimage — The tribulations are the ordeals counted against the pilgrims.
  • Location: Flaming Mountains — Crossing the Flaming Mountains is one of the numbered ordeals.

What is Eighty-one tribulations?

The eighty-one tribulations are the novel's plot engine: demons who want Sanzang's flesh, false monasteries, and divine tests counted so the west may be paid for in hardship.

Key threads lead to Tang pilgrimage and Flaming Mountains.
